newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU tender date subject to official publication.
newsitem.headline: EU tender date subject to official publication.

text.p: The July 17 date targeted as the opening of European Union grain export tenders this year is subject to official publication, officials said.
That is a formality but the regulations for wheat, barley and rye export tenders adopted on Thursday will not come into force on July 17 if they have not been published first.
Some EU grain regulations have been held up by a backlog in translation work in the past, but officials said there was no reason to think the July 17 opening date would be missed.
The tenders allow traders to bid for wheat, barley and rye export subsidies.
Agreement in Brussels to open the tenders is not expected to lead quickly back to active exports, but is seen as a sign of EU willingness to end a two-month break with world markets.
The EU is holding back an export tender for oats pending a solution to legal problems concerning transitional arrangements for recent members Finland and Sweden.
